evidence_status: Preregistered simulation layout and software-audit contract only; no human labels or empirical model outputs have been collected.

decision.local_alternative_formula: sign*practical_margin + direction*c/sqrt(fixed_budget_attempts), for sign and direction in {-1,+1}

fractional_screen.resolution_requirement: No main-effect column may equal the intercept, another main-effect column, or any two-factor interaction column.

condition_construction.screening_block: Cross all 16 fractional rows, three boundary effects, and three model regimes.
condition_construction.center_boundary_block: Cross the center condition, three boundary effects, and three model regimes.
condition_construction.local_alternative_block: Cross the center condition, all 12 signed local alternatives, and three model regimes.

common_estimator: Every acquisition policy uses the same prequential augmented Hansen--Hurwitz estimator; estimator augmentation is then ablated at fixed policy.

monte_carlo.condition_seed: first 64 bits of sha256(canonical-json(condition)) xor base_seed
monte_carlo.pairing: Within condition and trial, every acquisition policy receives the same latent frame and complete potential-outcome stream; policy randomization uses a separate policy-keyed seed.
monte_carlo.reporting: Report Monte Carlo standard errors for bias, coverage, false decisions, abstention, realized loss, interval width, maximum weight, and effective sample size.

blocking_requirements: Executable DGP equations for all three model regimes
Explicit MCAR, rater-dependent, and outcome-dependent missingness laws without claiming MAR for the latter
Hash-frozen implementations of every acquisition policy and the common estimator
Resource estimate and deterministic restart/checkpoint rule
Independent review of the EVI implementation and terminal-action comparison
limitations: A resolution-IV-style screening layout estimates main effects without main--two-factor aliasing, but two-factor interactions remain aliased and require targeted follow-up.
The fractional design is a preregistered stress screen, not a substitute for application-specific power analysis.
Freezing the layout does not make the simulation executable while its DGP and policy implementations remain unfrozen.
